## Reusable rules

1. **Keep concrete operations inside the service interface** A namespace-level concrete operation can emit an unintended `POST /`; define it inside the service interface or make it templated. The author moved `create` into `DataGenerationJobs` in reply. *Scope:* TypeSpec operations whose route should be scoped to a service path. *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4084484170, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4087663010

2. **Make optionality and defaults agree with service behavior** Reviewers challenged optional fields without documented service defaults and requested an explicit `write_mode` default. The final patch gives write modes a TypeSpec default and documents it, but evaluation output `name` remains optional despite the earlier request; treat that point as unresolved. *Scope:* Optional request/output properties and defaults in TypeSpec models. *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4085734588, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4087468789, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4085744442, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4087469301, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4095492244, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4096627321, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/5373caee4c2a1bde82b3456ea87496ef3733c054/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/data_generation_jobs/models.tsp

3. **Regenerate artifacts against CI and inspect unrelated diffs** The review reported that generated OpenAPI files differed from CI regeneration and included unrelated schemas, and asked for a clean regeneration. This is a repository workflow lesson, not a general TypeSpec schema rule. *Scope:* Generated OpenAPI artifacts accompanying TypeSpec changes. *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#pullrequestreview-5293403085

4. **Treat compatibility strategy as version-specific** The thread disagreed on whether changing the request shape required a new preview opt-in or whether the new shape could be the GA shape while the service temporarily accepted both. The final patch uses an optional v1 preview header and the new typed request models; do not infer that backend compatibility alone guarantees schema compatibility or that old SDK fields should always be retained. *Scope:* API-version and preview compatibility decisions for changed request shapes. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4084484183, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4087465563, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4152279746, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247#discussion_r4157310080, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/5373caee4c2a1bde82b3456ea87496ef3733c054/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/data_generation_jobs/routes.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/5373caee4c2a1bde82b3456ea87496ef3733c054/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/data_generation_jobs/models.tsp

5. **Model scenario-specific shapes explicitly** The frozen patch establishes a `scenario` discriminator and scenario-specific input/resource models with matching output target types. This is evidence for this declaration pattern, not a universal requirement to split every model. *Scope:* Data-generation job models in this PR. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46247, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/5373caee4c2a1bde82b3456ea87496ef3733c054/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/data_generation_jobs/models.tsp

## Caveats

- The preview/GA and backward-compatibility comments conflict; the frozen HEAD patch is the evidence for the resulting declaration, not proof of service or schema compatibility.
- Optionality feedback was only partly reconciled in the supplied evidence: the final patch still has optional evaluation output `name`.
- The PR description lists compile and format commands, but no tests or validation were run for this extraction. The review’s regeneration report is attributed feedback, not validation performed here.
- Sixteen empty-body review records appear only in metadata and are intentionally excluded from coverage receipts as requested; generated artifact files were also deliberately omitted. No evidence units were unread.
